messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: piecewise regression
parts: Could we use lavaan to conduct a piecewise regression analysis with unknown change point?

No, the growth-factor loadings must be fixed in advance.  There are ways to model unknown change points in MCMC estimation.  Perhaps ask on the blavaan forum whether it is possible.
